pages.text:
Splits water with FE: 1 mB of water makes 2 mB of Hydrogen and 1 mB of Oxygen, like the real thing.
- At least {fe:1416} FE per mB of water (708 per mB of hydrogen) at 400 FE/t: the floor, since hydrogen must always cost more FE than any setup can get back by burning it (its recipe's 1,200 is below that, so Energy upgrades don't lower it). Brine splits for 600 FE per mB, which Energy upgrades can cut down to the floor.
- Water goes in through Input faces (the top by default). Hydrogen and Oxygen leave through their own faces (left and right by default) into Pressurized Conduits, Cylinders or Gas Cartridges.
- It also splits Brine into Hydrogen, Chlorine (by the Oxygen face) and Lye, which leaves by Output faces (the bottom by default): see Salt & Chlor-Alkali.
- A full gas tank stops it. To keep only one gas, switch on the vent under the other tank in its GUI: whatever doesn't fit is released and splitting carries on.
- Takes Speed and Energy upgrades and a redstone setting.
